['Reemtsma Cigarettenfabriken GmbH '].company_description: Reemtsma Cigarettenfabriken GmbH is one of the biggest tobacco and cigarette manufacturing companies in Europe and a subsidiary of Imperial Brands. The company's headquarters is in Hamburg, Germany. The company's products include the Juno brand of cigarettes.

['Adecco Germany Holding SA & Co. KG '].company_description: Adecco Germany Holding SA & Co. KG is a leading talent company that provides human resource services, including temporary staffing, permanent placement, outsourcing, and career transition. It operates through two business lines: Staffing and Solutions. The company's purpose is to enable sustainable and lifelong employability for individuals and deliver digital and engineering solutions to power the Smart Industry transformation.
